scope: Independent signal and duration audit of all 90 generated raw PCM WAVs; no playback, ASR, pronunciation, semantic completeness, or perceived naturalness assessment was performed.

reviewThresholds.note: Broad heuristic screening thresholds detect conspicuous signal issues, not speech omissions or quality.

interpretation: No conspicuous missing/zero audio, anomalous duration, or long quiet intervals were found. Short near/full-scale runs are present in original TTS PCM and retained unchanged. Their audibility and speech correctness cannot be determined from this numeric audit. signalAuditPass=false means the deliberately sensitive near-full-scale screen flagged samples; it does not assert audible distortion or require regeneration.
